title: Convert Speed to $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$
text: First, convert the initial speed from $$\tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{h}}$$ to $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}.$$ Remember that $$1\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$ is equal to $$1/3.6\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$.

title: Calculate Initial Speed in $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$
text: Use the conversion factor to find the initial speed in $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}.$$ What is $$1000\, \tfrac{\text{km}}{\text{hr}}$$ in $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$?

title: Initial Speed in $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$
text: Calculate the initial speed in $$\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}}$$ using the conversion factor.

title: Use the Formula for Acceleration
text: The formula for acceleration is $$a=(v_{f}-v_{i})/t,$$ where $$v_{f}$$ is the final velocity, $$v_{i}$$ is the initial velocity, and $$t$$ is the time.

title: Calculate Acceleration
text: Substitute the values into the formula: $$v_{f}=0\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}},$$ $$v_{i}=277.78\,\tfrac{\text{m}}{\text{s}},$$ and $$t=1.10\, \text{s}$$.
